gaps.sentence: The children are looking forward to ___ Father Christmas.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: looking forward to meeting.

gaps.sentence: He stopped ___ coffee before bed and now sleeps much better.
gaps.explanation: 'Stop doing' = quit the activity; 'stop to drink' would mean pause in order to drink.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
